name: hero
prompt: The hero: a woman in her late twenties who runs errands nobody asks about. Thin and pale, tired eyes, dark hair pulled back in a messy bun. Like everyone, she wears a partial helmet over her right eye: a heavy, grey, steampunk-like device of riveted metal plates and a round lens, covering the whole eye and her temple. A long, cheap raincoat in faded grey-maroon, open and hanging loose, over a worn black top and leggings, scuffed boots to the knee.
concierge: The Concierge's version of her, a striking cyberpunk look: an asymmetric undercut, one side shaved, long hair swept over the other side in neon green fading to purple. Bold make-up with dark lips and sharp eyeliner, the partial helmet over her right eye a smooth, seamless white shell with a soft blue light, covering the whole eye. A cropped black top, fitted high-waisted black trousers, a long glossy red coat with thin neon trims, chunky black platform boots. Confident, glamorous and attractive. Same pose.

left.raw: Seen from her left side, her left eye is uncovered; her eye device is on her right eye, out of sight, with only its strap over her hair.
left.concierge: Seen from her left side, her left eye is uncovered and her long green-to-purple hair falls over this side of her head; the device and the shaved side of her undercut are on her right, out of sight.

parts.right: Seen from her right side, her eye device covers her whole right eye and temple.
